Iran to Release Frozen Assets Amid US Talks and Market Volatility

Iran announced that Qatar will release $6 billion in frozen assets, with the Iranian president calling it a "great victory." This development occurs as peace talks with the US face challenges and amid ongoing uncertainties in the Persian Gulf. The situation has contributed to volatility in oil prices, with some outlets noting a connection to US retail fuel costs.
